nameOrigin: wooden container often holding water or liquid

pokedexEntries.di: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

pokedexEntries.prl: While its movements out of water are sluggish, it can swim as fast as any FEEBAS.

pokedexEntries.pt: A river dammed by BIBAREL will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.
